string-array.name: whats_new_items
string-array.item: All the voice engines are faster, and voices start speaking sooner: about a second or less on most phones. (Kokoro needs its update from the Engines screen.)
Five new Pocket voices: Mary, Rita, Stephen, Ramone and Jenny.
Expressiveness: choose how lively each Pocket voice sounds, from Steady to Lively, in its alias.
The German engine has been fixed.
